meta.title: feat(editor): exclude storybook files and implement code splitting without lazy loading
meta.body_summary: Implement code splitting via Vite manual chunks, exclude Storybook files, and remove lazy loading for synchronous imports, claiming optimized bundle sizes.

perf_labels.notes: Devin removed lazy loading and added storybook exclusion; maintainer zhyd1997 reverted vite/layout changes, then PR closed by bot for inactivity.

The PR was not merged; the maintainer flagged specific files not to be changed, and after revert, the PR was auto-closed due to inactivity.
